title: OpenCode 2 with a local model
description: OpenCode 2 with a model on your own server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM or another OpenAI-compatible one) and nothing else: only the server's address is opened.

de.title: OpenCode 2 mit einem lokalen Modell
de.description: OpenCode 2 mit einem Modell auf Ihrem eigenen Server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM oder ein anderer OpenAI-kompatibler) und sonst nichts: nur die Adresse des Servers ist offen.

llm.label: LLM server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add ollama --kind ollama --url http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model MODEL

notes: Register the server once: sandbox-ai llm add NAME --kind ollama|lmstudio|llamacpp|vllm|openai-compatible --url URL --model MODEL; sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent opencode2 asks it for the API OpenCode 2 uses.

OpenCode 2 gets the server as OpenCode 1 does, read-only: an OpenAI-compatible provider in /etc/opencode2/sandbox-ai-llm.json with the key as a placeholder the connection proxy replaces, the model in its configuration layer (no project file points it elsewhere), and --no-provider-defaults offers no other provider.

The relay sets the model's parameters (sandbox-ai llm params) and the loop guard on the wire, the same for every agent; OpenCode 2 gets the loop guard's steps, compaction and instructions in its file too. Agents need a model with tool calls and a long context (qwen3-coder, gpt-oss, ...; Ollama: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 or more). On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman.
OpenCode 2 is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build opencode2.
